race.title: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SAILING BY is one of the least exposed and shaped as if this increase in trip was worth exploring when third at Fontwell 3 weeks ago. He could be worth siding with from a further reduced mark with his yard continuing in excellent form. Huntingdon scorer Cinnodin might be the danger. SAILING BY (IRE) CINNODIN BETTY'S TIARA
race.bettingForecast: Cinnodin (13/8), Betty's Tiara (5/2), Robber's Bridge (7/2), Sailing By (4/1), Lord Of All Saints (5/1), One Cool Dreamer (33/1)
